title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-06-06

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a 1970 acoustic fragment, highlighted by a stellar Frozen Logger and crystal‑clear Friend Of The Devil.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as fantastic and perfect, delivering crisp, clean acoustic sound from the 1970 show. Reviewers especially love Bob Weir’s vocal performance and cite The Frozen Logger and an acoustic Friend Of The Devil as standout moments, even though the set is incomplete.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviews are positive about both performance and sound quality; average user rating (excluding a non‑rating) is 4.33, supporting a strong overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crystal‑clear acoustic mix with no noticeable noise or dropouts; instruments and vocals are sharply defined.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Fragmentary acoustic set from 1970—short but well‑recorded, offering a tasty glimpse of the band's early acoustic work.

band_member_comments.Bob: Weir's vocals are singled out as particularly strong on this fragment.
